Instruments.spectrum_analyzer_signal_hound.Trace Class¶

class Instruments.spectrum_analyzer_signal_hound.Trace(instrument, data_handler)[source]¶

Bases: object

The Trace commands control the user configurable traces for sweep mode.

select(trace_num)[source]¶

Specify the active trace index. All future operations will occur on this trace.

Parameters:

trace_num – Trace index [1,6].

set_average_count(count)[source]¶

Specify the number of sweeps that will be averaged together when trace is set to average type.

Parameters:

count – Number of traces to average together.

set_hide_state(state)[source]¶

Hide or show the trace.

Parameters:

state – 1/0 or ‘ON’/’OFF’ to show/hide the trace.

set_offset(value)[source]¶

Specify an offset in dB. Immediately applies to the trace.

Parameters:

value – Offset in dB to immediately apply to the trace.

set_smoothing_aperture(aperture)[source]¶

Specify the trace smoothing aperture as a percentage.

Parameters:

aperture – Smoothing aperture value.

set_smoothing_state(state)[source]¶

Enable or disable smoothing.

Parameters:

state – 1/0 or ‘ON’/’OFF’ to enable/disable trace smoothing.

set_spur_reject_state(state)[source]¶

Enable or disable trace spur rejection.

Parameters:

state – 1/0 or ‘ON’/’OFF’ to enable/disable spur reject.

set_spur_reject_threshold(value)[source]¶

Specify the spur reject threshold in dB.

Parameters:

value – Spur reject threshold in dB.

set_type(typ)[source]¶

Specify the trace type. AVERage:COUNt sweeps and REFerence stops the trace from updating (effectively holding the current values).

Parameters:

typ – ‘OFF’, ‘NORMal’, ‘AVERage’, ‘REFerence’, ‘MINHold’, or ‘MAXHold’.

set_update_state(state)[source]¶

Specify if the trace updates when a new sweep is acquired from the device.

Parameters:

state – 1/0 or ‘ON’/’OFF’ to enable/disable trace update.

to(trace_num)[source]¶

Move the current trace to the selected trace. The selected trace type will be set to reference.

Parameters:

trace_num – Trace index [1,6] to move the current trace to.

__init__(instrument, data_handler)[source]¶
clear()[source]¶

Clear the selected trace. For example, if the current sweep is a max hold sweep and is cleared, the trace will be replaced with the next sweep from the device.

clear_all()[source]¶

Clear all the traces.

copy(dest_trace_num)[source]¶

Copy the currently selected trace to the trace specified by the supplied parameter. The supplied parameter should be between [1,6] and not equal to the currently selected trace. If the destination trace type is off, the trace type is set to clear and write. Update is set to off and display is set to on for the destination trace.

Parameters:

dest_trace_num – Destination trace index [1,6], not equal to current.

get_xincrement()[source]¶

Frequency step between two points in the trace data (Hz).

get_xstart()[source]¶

Retrieve the frequency of the first point in the sweep as Hz. Useful for calculating the frequency of each point in the trace data returned from the :TRACe:DATA? command.

Returns:

Frequency of the first point in the sweep (Hz).
